SOME ASPECTS OF THE AGNI-MYTHOLOGY IN THE VEDA

Introduction

The subject of my lectures1 is “Some Aspects of the Agni-Mythology in the Veda”. Accordingly, my aim, in these lectures, will not be to present any detailed and connected statement about the Agni-mythology as a whole; I shall only endeavour to emphasize certain points relating to Agni as he figures in the Vedic mythology and ritual – points, which, I think, do not usually receive sufficient attention. Of course, while doing so, I shall have to presume, on the part of my listeners, a general acquaintance with the broad outlines of the Agni-mythology.
